g.text: The same count of areas is reached by different rules, and the maps differ

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'Hiragino Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #334155

g.text: England and Wales 2021. 4 core settings give 223 to 247 areas; with three attachment thresholds each, 12 maps.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'Hiragino Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Number of areas = number of core groups; the attachment threshold moves units between areas without changing the count. Agreement weighted by employed residents.
